hasBand: {host} waves from the champion's box. "Is that a Dynamax Band? Then you already know the stage you're standing on."
"Show me what it can do. The whole country is watching."
givesBand: {host} walks down from the champion's box and the stadium goes silent. "Every challenger needs one of these."
"It lets a Pokémon grow huge for a few turns. It's the heart of the Gym Challenge. Wear it well."
{host} fastens the Dynamax Band around your wrist. "Welcome to the Gym Challenge. Make it a battle people remember."

hostLines.text: Welcome to the stage! Don't mind the cameras. They'll love you.
Every great challenger started right where you're standing.
Another stadium, another roar. You're settling in nicely.
Keep smiling. The crowd can tell when a challenger is enjoying it.
A rough one last time? It happens. The crowd remembers how you get back up.
That last match had the whole stadium talking. Do it again.
I've been watching your matches. You're getting better every round.
People are starting to say your name in the stands.
Tough stretch. I won't make it easier, but I'm still rooting for you.
That was not a challenger's win. That was a statement.
You don't fight like someone who's just here for the badges anymore.
Only a few challengers ever make it this far. You're one of them.
You've lost before and kept going. That is exactly what a champion does.
Flawless. I'd say I'm worried, but I'm mostly excited.
I'll stop calling you a challenger. You're a competitor. See you in the tournament.
Nobody gets here without a few scars. I'm still expecting a great match from you.
If you keep this up, we'll be facing each other soon. I can't wait.
